# NORTH SPAN

## Project
- Subtitle: Sport and everyday passage beneath the viaduct
- Direction: exposed concrete structure, bounded sports bays, southern through-route, northern planted seating
- Site area: 1,728 m²
- Boundary: 72 m east–west × 24 m north–south
- Coordinate origin: southwest corner; x eastward; y northward
- Coordinate unit in site records: mm
- Ground level: z = 0.01y; southwest datum z = 0 mm
- Ground rise across site: 240 mm
- Bridge footprint: x = 0–72,000 mm; y = 6,000–24,000 mm
- Bridge underside: z = 6,240 mm
- Minimum bridge clearance: 6,000 mm
- New fixtures: freestanding; maximum height 3,000 mm above local ground

## Existing structure
- Columns: six; square shafts 1,200 mm × 1,200 mm
- Column centres: x = 12,000, 36,000 and 60,000 mm; y = 8,000 and 20,000 mm
- Column spacing: 24,000 mm longitudinal; 12,000 mm transverse
- Foundation footprint: 2,400 mm × 2,400 mm centred on each column
- Protection footprint: 4,000 mm × 4,000 mm centred on each column; clear maintenance space
- Drainage channel: x = 0–72,000 mm; y = 4,500–4,800 mm; flush grated cover

## Zones
| Zone | South–north extent | Area | Surface | Shade | Operating allowance |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---:|
| Shared Way | y = 0–4,000 mm | 288 m² | Broom-finished concrete | Open sky | 40 moving users |
| Service Strip | y = 4,000–5,500 mm | 108 m² | Brushed concrete and flush steel drainage grating | Open sky | 2 maintenance staff |
| Activity Floor | y = 5,500–21,000 mm | 1,116 m² | Acrylic-coated asphalt at basketball; wet-pour rubber at tennis and fitness; broom-finished concrete approaches | Existing bridge, y = 6,000–21,000 mm | 40 users and spectators |
| Garden Edge | y = 21,000–24,000 mm | 216 m² | Concrete access pads, timber seats and raised planting beds | Existing bridge | 18 seated users |

## Programme and operation
- Basketball practice enclosure: 16 m × 12 m; one hoop
- Table tennis: two adjoining activity envelopes, each 6 m × 10 m; one table per envelope
- Fitness: one 6 m × 10 m envelope; one pull-up station and two stretching rails
- Shared Way: continuous 4 m clear width; west and east entrances
- Public access: 06:00–22:00 daily
- Sports use: 08:00–21:00 daily
- Passage lighting: dusk–22:00
- Main scene times: 10:00 and 21:30
- Film duration: 12 seconds
- Film states: 18:30 sports use; 21:30 passage

## Planting and materials
- Planting beds: six; each 6 m × 2 m; total planted area 72 m²
- Bed construction: freestanding precast concrete planters, 600 mm high, 450 mm growing medium depth
- Irrigation: drip lines within all six beds
- Seats: timber slats on freestanding steel frames
- Sports enclosure: freestanding steel mesh panels, 3,000 mm high
| Code | Botanical name | Stock size | Total quantity | Quantity per bed |
|---|---|---|---:|---:|
| DF | Dryopteris filix-mas | 2 L container | 72 | 12 |
| CP | Carex pendula | 2 L container | 96 | 16 |
| GM | Geranium macrorrhizum | 2 L container | 120 | 20 |

## Implementation areas
| Phase | Scope | Area |
|---|---|---:|
| South Link | Shared Way and Service Strip | 396 m² |
| Activity Bays | Activity Floor | 1,116 m² |
| Garden Finish | Garden Edge | 216 m² |

## Fixed wording
- Site name: NORTH SPAN
- Zone names: Shared Way; Service Strip; Activity Floor; Garden Edge
- Plant names: Dryopteris filix-mas; Carex pendula; Geranium macrorrhizum

steps.userMessage:
NORTH SPAN | Sport and everyday passage beneath the viaduct

We are turning the space beneath our neighbourhood viaduct into a public sports ground that also carries everyday walking and cycling. The direction is fixed: exposed concrete columns, clearly bounded activity bays, a continuous southern through-route and planted seating along the northern edge. The rectangular site measures 72 m east–west by 24 m north–south, totalling 1,728 m². Six existing columns stand on a 24 m longitudinal grid and a 12 m transverse grid. Each column has a 4 m × 4 m protection square. The existing ground rises northward at 1%; the minimum clearance beneath the bridge is 6,000 mm.

Organise the site into four fixed bands: Shared Way, 288 m²; Service Strip, 108 m²; Activity Floor, 1,116 m²; and Garden Edge, 216 m². The Shared Way is a continuous 4 m-wide connection between the west and east entrances. The Service Strip contains the existing drainage channel. The Activity Floor contains a 16 m × 12 m basketball practice enclosure, two adjoining 6 m × 10 m table-tennis envelopes and one 6 m × 10 m fitness envelope. Their coordinates are fixed in the site records. Spectator seating and approaches occupy the remaining space around these envelopes. Garden Edge contains six planted beds, each 6 m × 2 m, with a combined palette of 72 Dryopteris filix-mas, 96 Carex pendula and 120 Geranium macrorrhizum. Public access runs from 06:00 to 22:00; sports use runs from 08:00 to 21:00. Lighting serves passage until 22:00. All new fixtures are freestanding and at most 3,000 mm high.

Print the site name as "NORTH SPAN". Use "Shared Way" and "Activity Floor" as the corresponding wayfinding labels. Print all four zone names and all three botanical names on the masterplan and ground and planting sheet, using the spelling in the site records.

Audience: pedestrians and cyclists crossing the neighbourhood, nearby residents using the sports facilities, and the public-space team deciding the layout and operating arrangements.

Inputs (attached): 01-client-facts.en.md contains the fixed project facts. 02-delivery-catalog.en.md lists the deliverables, proportions, formats and stages. 03-site-records.en.md contains coordinates, zone areas, operating allowances, materials and planting quantities. 04-column-grid.png supplies the boundary, column grid, protection squares, drainage and activity envelopes. 05-clearance-section.png supplies the transverse ground slope, foundation edges and bridge clearance. 06-existing-structure.png establishes the existing concrete columns, bridge soffit and ground character to retain. 07-evening-use.png provides context for residents exercising and watching at dusk. 08-night-passage.png provides context for walking and cycling after the sports session.

Deliverables:
1. One one-page site analysis and zoning schedule stating the four zone names and areas, surface types, shade sources, operating allowances and three-species planting palette
2. One circulation and sports masterplan with north arrow, scale bar, boundary dimensions, activity envelopes, protection squares and lighting positions, repeating the analysis schedule's four zone names and areas and three botanical names
3. Two dimensioned sections: a transverse section at x = 36 m and a longitudinal section through the Shared Way at y = 2 m
4. Three facility and boundary sheets: basketball enclosure edge plus Shared Way–Service Strip interface; table-tennis spectator edge; and fitness equipment footing and approach
5. Two ground and planting sheets: a paving and planting layout with materials and plant quantities; and a surface-junction and lighting-location plan, both carrying the four zone names and areas from the analysis schedule
6. Three occupied perspectives of one layout: east entrance at 10:00, west entrance at 21:30, and the east-entrance camera repeated at 21:30
7. One 12-second film moving from a sports boundary and spectators at 18:30 to the illuminated Shared Way at 21:30
8. One presentation document of at least 8 pages reusing the analysis schedule, masterplan, sections, details, planting and occupied views, with the four zone areas and three botanical names repeated

Acceptance:
- The site analysis and zoning schedule comes first and records Shared Way at 288 m², Service Strip at 108 m², Activity Floor at 1,116 m² and Garden Edge at 216 m²; the masterplan, both ground and planting sheets and presentation repeat these names and areas.
- The masterplan and both sections show the 72 m × 24 m boundary, continuous 4 m-wide Shared Way, six recorded protection squares and existing drainage channel; the transverse section labels the 1% slope, minimum 6,000 mm bridge clearance and maximum 3,000 mm fixture height.
- The masterplan and three facility and boundary sheets retain the recorded 16 m × 12 m basketball enclosure, two 6 m × 10 m table-tennis envelopes and 6 m × 10 m fitness envelope, with spectator seating and approaches located around them.
- The masterplan, paving and planting layout and presentation print NORTH SPAN and all three botanical names from the analysis schedule; the paving and planting layout identifies DF × 72, CP × 96 and GM × 120 within six 6 m × 2 m beds and repeats all four zone names.
- The three perspectives and 12-second film follow the masterplan's facility, planting and lighting positions; the paired east-entrance views retain the same camera, the 10:00 and 18:30 scenes show sports use, and the 21:30 scenes show illuminated passage with sports equipment at rest.
- The presentation contains at least 8 pages and reuses the submitted schedule, masterplan, both sections, all three detail sheets, planting layout and all three perspectives, including the 06:00–22:00 access hours and 08:00–21:00 sports hours.

Please clearly mark which version you consider the final deliverable. If nothing is marked, the last exported version counts.
